H6PA05216.name: Nicholas Manganaro
H6PA05216.bio: Retired finance professional who worked as a Wall Street bond trader, portfolio manager and risk manager.

positions.stance: Will "work across the aisle on a credible path to balance the budget" and opposes new entitlement expansions that widen the structural deficit.
Says the most effective way to make living more affordable is to "welcome high value-added manufacturers and the jobs and wages they provide."
Supports funding current operations in Iran but hopes the situation "can be quickly resolved through a negotiated settlement of hostilities."
Supports "ICE’s continuing efforts to remove criminals and to reduce the amount of fentanyl entering our country," and the Deporting Fraudsters Act.
Believes laws should apply evenly to all; supports impeaching judges who free offenders who commit murder after multiple arrests.

H8PA06087.name: Chrissy Houlahan
H8PA06087.bio: U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 6th District since 2019; former U.S. Air Force Reserve captain, COO of AND1 Basketball, B-Lab co-founder and Teach for America chemistry teacher.

positions.stance: "I believe in the Department of Defense and that diplomacy and our allies are integral to our national security."
"I believe that healthcare is a right."
Believes "a living wage is necessary."
Believes "climate change is urgent."
Believes "quality education enables people to live better lives."

H6PA06156.name: Marty Young
H6PA06156.bio: West Point graduate and former Army infantry officer, Army National Guard chaplain, and corporate restructuring executive.

positions.stance: Will work to "cut wasteful deficit spending that fuels inflation, including unnecessary foreign aid" and funding to unaccountable non-government organizations.
Supports term limits, banning insider trading by members of Congress, and ending the revolving door for elected officials leaving office.
Supports universal coverage for children and young adults up to age 23 and comprehensive care for expectant mothers.
Will not support efforts to defund the police; says law enforcement "must be properly funded, well-trained, and equipped."
Supports "an all-of-the-above energy approach focused on reliability and affordability," including natural gas, nuclear and responsible renewables.

H8PA15195.name: Ryan Mackenzie
H8PA15195.bio: U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 7th District since 2025 and former Pennsylvania State Representative.

positions.stance: Will continue pursuing further tax relief for working families, lower health care and prescription costs, expanded American energy, and better control of government spending.
Refused to support any budget reducing Social Security benefits and will "continue the fight to preserve Social Security and Medicare for the future."
Supports Child Tax Credit and childcare tax credit proposals and other commonsense initiatives "that make life easier for working families."
Seeks to "crack down on congressional stock trading" and backs legislation establishing congressional term limits.
Will continue to advocate for the district's "fair share of federal dollars to address important local needs."

H6PA07188.name: Bob Brooks
H6PA07188.bio: Former 20-year Bethlehem firefighter and president of the Pennsylvania Professional Fire Fighters Association.

positions.stance: Supports repealing Citizens United and wants to "Ban corporate PAC money from politics, period."
"No stock trading in Congress. If you want to get rich, don’t run for office."
Supports term limits: "No more lifetime politicians."
"Fair taxes for the rich"; supports a billionaire minimum tax and repealing the 2017 tax cuts for billionaires and big corporations.
Supports restoring Medicaid cuts and providing Medicare for All.

H4PA08124.name: Rob Bresnahan
H4PA08124.bio: U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 8th District; former CEO of Kuharchik Construction and founder of RPB Ventures.

positions.stance: "We must secure the border, build the wall" and reverse prior policies to stop the flow of illegal drugs and criminals.
Says we need to "stop the reckless spending, get inflation under control, and cut taxes so you can keep more of the money you earn."
"I will not support raising the retirement age or any benefit cuts to these programs."
Will "always stand with law enforcement" and ensure they have the resources to combat the fentanyl crisis.
"I will vote for commonsense policies that unleash the American economy and get Pennsylvania back to work."
Supports a ban on congressional stock trading: "No one should be able to use their public office to enrich themselves."
Will reject corporate PAC money as a candidate and member of Congress to avoid the influence of special interests.
Supports auditing the federal government to cut waste, fraud and abuse "with a scalpel, not a chainsaw."
Supports breaking up "the huge monopolies that hurt our small businesses and raise costs."
Supports strengthening unions and making it "easier to join and start a union."

H8PA10147.name: Dan Meuser
H8PA10147.bio: U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 9th District in his fourth term; former president of Pride Mobility Products USA and Pennsylvania Secretary of Revenue.

positions.stance: Supports preserving strong border policies, ending catch and release, and giving Border Patrol agents the resources needed to enforce the law.
Supports lower taxes and cutting "burdensome regulations" to create good-paying jobs, lower costs, and help families keep more of what they earn.
Supports expanding domestic energy production, "particularly Pennsylvania natural gas," to lower utility bills and reduce dependence on foreign adversaries.
Supports maintaining "the world’s strongest military" and prioritizing readiness and war-fighting capabilities.
Supports protecting President Trump’s tax relief and cutting red tape so small businesses can invest, expand and hire.

H6PA09127.name: Rachel Wallace
H6PA09127.bio: Former congressional staffer who served in the U.S. State Department, the U.S. Senate and the White House as Chief of Staff for the Office of Management and Budget.

positions.stance: Would reverse the 2025 health care cuts and ban insurer prior authorization "so they can no longer deny doctor-prescribed care."
Will fight for trade and technical school funding and for working people's ability to form a union; defends the Davis-Bacon Act.
Will fight monopolies in fertilizer, seeds and meatpacking and supports Right to Repair laws for farmers.
Will vote to establish "a new first-time homebuyer credit and a starter home construction credit."
Supports a ban on members of Congress and their spouses trading individual stocks.

H2PA04135.name: Scott Perry
H2PA04135.bio: U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 10th District, in Congress since 2013; retired Army Brigadier General, former state representative, and co-founder of a mechanical contracting firm.

positions.stance: Will continue to fight for a Balanced Budget Amendment, less government regulation, reducing the national debt, and lower taxes on families and small businesses.
Supports "a strong, legal immigration system," securing borders, deporting violent criminals, and banning sanctuary cities.
Supports "a blended energy portfolio" including clean energy technologies and domestic resources to reduce dependence on foreign energy.
Supports preserving and protecting Medicare and Social Security; opposes "Medicare for All" and single-payer health care.
Opposes government-run health care; supports coverage of pre-existing conditions, lower prescription drug costs, expanded HSAs, and buying insurance across state lines.

H4PA10104.name: Janelle Stelson
H4PA10104.bio: Former longtime local newscaster in Central Pennsylvania.

positions.stance: "I support tax breaks for the hard-working middle class, not billionaires"; would vote to make no tax on tips or overtime permanent.
"I will repeal these tariff taxes that are increasing costs."
Would "vote to end the war in Iran."
Plans to stop Wall Street from buying up homes, cut red tape to build homes faster, and expand small-dollar home loans.
Supports 12-year term limits, age limits for members, and banning members and their families from trading individual stocks.

H6PA16320.name: Lloyd Smucker
H6PA16320.bio: U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 11th District; former two-term Pennsylvania state senator and longtime owner of the Smucker Company.

positions.stance: Will keep fighting so working families "can keep more of their hard earned dollars," citing a bigger Child Tax Credit and tax relief on overtime and tips.
Working to protect Social Security for today’s seniors and future generations and to give workers without employer retirement plans a new way to save.
Working "to cut wasteful spending, reduce deficits, and confront America's growing national debt."
Seeks to "lower insurance premiums, hold insurance executives accountable, and give patients more affordable health care choices."
Supports producing more American energy and cutting permitting delays; says renewable energy decisions "should be driven by the free market, not government."

H6PA11099.name: Nancy Mannion
H6PA11099.bio: Former emergency nurse and international healthcare leader.

positions.stance: Will fight to raise the federal minimum wage and believes getting rid of the Trump tariffs will help bring down grocery and other costs.
Supports "affordable healthcare for all and lower prescription medication costs" and reversing healthcare budget cuts.
Believes reproductive decisions "should be made only between the patient, their family, and a medical provider."
Supports stronger gun laws and more mental health support in schools; opposes tax credits or vouchers that push money toward private schools.
Supports strong borders, ICE focused on those with serious criminal records, and a pathway to citizenship for groups such as Dreamers and asylum seekers.

H2PA18200.name: Summer Lee
H2PA18200.bio: U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 12th District since 2023; former Pennsylvania state representative, organizer and attorney.

positions.stance: Supports federal automatic voter registration, nationwide early and mail voting, federal holidays for election days, and same day voter registration.
Fighting for "comprehensive campaign finance reform that ends Citizens United and puts campaigns back into the hands of the people."
Supports banning members of Congress from trading stocks and pledges "to never trade individual stocks while in office."
Fighting to end the filibuster, which she says "continues to stand in the way of progress today."
Supports enforcing real ethics requirements, ending lifetime appointments, and expanding the Supreme Court and federal courts.

H4PA12068.name: James Hayes
H4PA12068.bio: Business executive whose career included six years with the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond.

positions.stance: Committed to policies that "support working families, bring back good-paying union jobs, and protect small business owners."
Supports law enforcement, investing in crime prevention, and "making sure repeat violent offenders are held accountable."
"I support expanding school choice so families can find the best fit for their children."
Believes every person should be treated with dignity and supports "standing by our allies, including Israel, to keep America and the world safe."
Supports "an all-of-the-above energy strategy that keeps our lights on, creates local jobs, and breaks our dependence on foreign powers."

H8PA13125.name: John Joyce
H8PA13125.bio: U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 13th District since 2019 and a dermatologist who practiced in Altoona for over 25 years.

H4PA13298.name: Beth Farnham
H4PA13298.bio: Stay-at-home parent in Adams County ready to return to the paid workforce.

positions.stance: Pledges to increase the number of U.S. Representatives and support legislation requiring members of Congress to hold quarterly in-person town halls.
Pledges to "Enshrine into federal law Reproductive Freedom including, but not limited to: abortion, gender-affirming care, birth control, and IVF."
Pledges to "Substantially increase the federal minimum wage" and "Sharply reduce tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy."
Supports federal laws for safe firearm storage, reporting lost or stolen firearms, and universal background checks.
Says undocumented immigrants contribute to society while being "denied a path to legal residency and its benefits."

H8PA18199.name: Guy Reschenthaler
H8PA18199.bio: Iraq War veteran, former Navy prosecutor and former district magistrate.

positions.stance: "In Congress, I will fight to protect the people of southwestern PA and keep them safe" from ISIS, al-Qaida and other terrorist groups.
Will fight "to create jobs by cutting red tape and unshackling job creators."
Will fight to secure the border, reform the immigration system, "end sanctuary cities nationwide, and protect the jobs and wages of American workers."
"I will fight to make these tax cuts permanent," referring to the 2017 tax cuts.

H6PA14200.name: Alan Bradstock
H6PA14200.bio: Desert Storm combat veteran and retired FBI agent.

positions.stance: Calls for "policies that raise wages, strengthen workers’ rights, and expand opportunities for small businesses and entrepreneurs."
"It’s time to guarantee health care as a right, not a privilege" through a universal system covering every American.
Will defend judicial independence, enforce anti-corruption laws, and ensure no president "can ever put themselves above the people."
Pledges to raise the standard of conduct in Washington so officials act with transparency and put the nation’s interests before personal gain.
Will work to "streamline operations, cut red tape, and use modern technology" to make government more transparent and cost-effective.

H8PA05071.name: Glenn Thompson
H8PA05071.bio: U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 15th District and Chairman of the House Agriculture Committee; formerly worked in health care and served as a volunteer firefighter and school board member.

positions.stance: Says he works hard for families, farmers and veterans "and for saving Medicare and Social Security."
"Fighting for the sanctity of human life for the innocent unborn and at every age and stage."

H6PA15181.name: Ray Bilger
H6PA15181.bio: Air Force veteran and intelligence analyst for the Air Force, National Security Agency and State Department; former NSA Technical Director for Cyber Analysis.

positions.stance: Supports helping small businesses hire locally and attracting good-paying jobs in manufacturing, defense, healthcare, cybersecurity and robotics.
"Congress must reclaim its constitutional authority over spending and tariffs rather than surrendering those powers to the executive branch."
Supports protecting affordable insurance coverage, lowering prescription drug costs, defending Medicare and Medicaid, and strengthening rural hospitals.
Supports passing the Agricultural Right to Repair Act, protecting crop insurance, and bringing tariff decisions back to Congress.
Says gas companies must follow Pennsylvania's laws, calling for "stronger oversight, real consequences for violations" and keeping energy benefits local.

H0PA03271.name: Mike Kelly
H0PA03271.bio: Small business owner, former school board member, and member of the U.S. House Ways and Means Committee.

positions.stance: Supports removing "onerous regulations that stifle private sector investment" and fixing the tax code so families have less of a tax burden.
Supports an "all of the above" and "everything below" energy approach, from coal and natural gas to nuclear, biofuels, solar and wind.
Supports adequate funding with local flexibility, "funding only what works, and expanding parental choice," plus career and technical education.
Will continue to support "robust funding for our military forces ensuring that they are fully equipped and trained to defend our country."
"We need to reduce the size of government and limit our spending" and keep each branch within its constitutional limits.

H6PA16379.name: Justin Wagner
H6PA16379.bio: Army veteran who deployed to Iraq and a senior automation engineer for the past 15 years.

positions.stance: "I will hold at least one in-person Townhall in our district every month."
Will vote to limit congressional service to a maximum of 12 years: six terms in the House and two in the Senate.
Will vote to ban members of Congress from trading individual stocks, calling it "corruption, plain and simple."
Will vote for "an at-minimum five-year moratorium before any former member of Congress can register as a lobbyist."
Will vote to overturn Citizens United to "end the era of unchecked dark money and corporate influence in our elections."

H2PA17103.name: Chris Deluzio
H2PA17103.bio: U.S. Representative for Western Pennsylvania since 2023; Iraq War veteran, former Navy officer and voting rights attorney.

H6PA17203.name: Tony Guy
H6PA17203.bio: Beaver County Sheriff and former 26-year Pennsylvania State Police officer.

positions.stance: "I will never back down to the radical left, and I will always represent the values of the people of Southwest Pennsylvania."
Supports pro-growth policies, reducing "Washington’s regulatory burden," and stopping the Washington spending spree he links to inflation.
Will "fight in lockstep" with President Trump to keep the border secure and supports making Remain in Mexico the law of the land.
"I BACK THE BLUE"; will oppose and block any efforts to defund the police.
Will "continue to be an ally for responsible gun owners across our Commonwealth."

H2IL01349.name: Jonathan Jackson
H2IL01349.bio: U.S. Representative for Illinois' 1st District and former professor at Chicago State University.

positions.stance: Supports the For the People Act and the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to "enhance voter access, counteract suppression, and ensure fair representation."
Strong advocate for Medicare for All and "expanding coverage to all Americans."
Endorses the Women's Health Protection Act "to safeguard reproductive freedoms."
Advocates expanding funding for under-resourced schools and improving early childhood education.

H6IL01191.name: Christian Maxwell
H6IL01191.bio: Businesswoman and marketing strategist with more than a decade of experience in marketing, brand growth and business strategy.

positions.stance: "I support safer communities, stronger policing, and real accountability," including cracking down on repeat violent offenders.
Supports "accountability and intervention," with federal youth-safety funding required to show measurable outcomes.
Supports "students first, parents heard, and schools held accountable," including accountability for failing schools.
"I believe parents are the primary decision-makers for their children"; supports federal parental-rights legislation preserving local control.
Supports erasing unpaid interest after 12 consecutive payments and crediting part of interest paid toward principal.

H6IL02355.name: Donna Miller
H6IL02355.bio: Cook County Commissioner and healthcare professional.

positions.stance: "Health care is a human right and I support a Medicare for All framework"; will fight to lower prescription drug costs and cap insulin prices.
In Congress, her focus will be "to codify Roe v. Wade and ensure every woman can make her own health care decisions."
Will stand with unions, "fight to repeal tax breaks for billionaires and support affordable housing investments."
Supports regulated blockchain integration and "strong and thoughtful federal regulation" of artificial intelligence, including export controls on advanced AI chips.
Will support rejoining the Paris Climate Agreement and continue "fighting for clean air, safe water and resilient infrastructure."

H6IL02389.name: Michael Noack
H6IL02389.bio: Truck driver from Bonfield in Kankakee County.

positions.stance: Wants to convert health insurance companies to nonprofit organizations, while opposing "socialized medicine" and government-run healthcare.
Supports investing in hydroelectric power as "proven, reliable, and genuinely renewable energy" and backing next-generation clean energy research.
Supports securing the border, refocusing ICE enforcement on violent criminals, and fixing the legal immigration process.
Will fight to roll back Illinois property taxes and the gas tax hike, and to "Cut wasteful federal spending."
Proposes a jobs pipeline placing veterans in police, airport security, shipyard and Coast Guard roles, and guaranteed access to healthcare and mental health services.
